mechanism: Paroxetine inhibits CYP2D6 which metabolizes nicotine, and nicotine induces CYP1A2 which metabolizes paroxetine, creating bidirectional metabolic interaction; both drugs have independent cardiovascular and CNS effects that may be additive.
action: Monitor for increased paroxetine side effects and nicotine toxicity; counsel on smoking cessation as clinically appropriate; assess cardiovascular stability; consider dose adjustments if needed.
